annotation.title_clean: Resolución 161/2023 - Agencia de Acceso a la Información Pública: Programa de transparencia y protección de datos personales en el uso de la Inteligencia Artificial
annotation.title_en: Resolution 161/2023 - Access to Public Information Agency: Programme for transparency and personal data protection in the use of Artificial Intelligence
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Agencia de Acceso a la Información Pública (AAIP), Argentina
annotation.venue: Boletín Oficial de la República Argentina
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Argentine AAIP Resolution 161/2023, published in the Boletín Oficial on 4 Sept 2023, creates a Programme on transparency and personal data protection in the use of AI, citing OECD AI Principles and UNESCO Recommendation. It instructs two national directorates to implement, monitor and evaluate it. The annex is not included.
key_provisions_or_claims: Article 1 creates the Programme of transparency and personal data protection in the use of AI (Annex IF-2023-99735227-APN-AAIP).
Article 2 instructs the transparency policy and data protection directorates to implement, monitor and evaluate the programme.
Grounded in OECD AI Principles, UNESCO AI Ethics Recommendation and Argentina's Disposición 2/2023 on trustworthy AI.
Aims to strengthen state capacities for analysis and regulation of AI in public and private sectors.
